title: 第9章 最好看的姑娘
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 那只粗糙的大拇指，抚了两遍她的唇，然后又捏捏她的下巴。最后双手都用上了，捧起她的脸，两片温热的唇就贴了过来。这对徐喜弟来说，是一种全新的体验。她竟也觉得十分美妙，不由自主地跟着他照做起来。两人之间有了互动，很快空气就有些不够用，他只能停下来喘一口。她也换了一口气。然后继续战斗。等她快断气再次停下来的时候，才发现自己已经变得果果的，衣服都不知去向，可他也并没有给更多的稍息时间，轻轻推着她躺下去。很快，床板开始轻轻摇动。一个床角抵着木板墙，笃，笃，笃，成了有节奏的乐章。隔壁的范金花，紧紧咬着唇，突然觉得自己好命苦。张国海的手此时也扣在她还算丰腴的腰上，跟着节奏一下一下地掐。范金花差点就想抬脚把他踹下床，但又害怕影响隔壁屋造人大计，所以只能咬牙忍着。原来能干的男人，是这样的，身上有用不完的力气。尤其在这个寂寞的夜晚，一声接一声的笃笃声，敲在她的心坎上。最后范金花眼角渗出泪来。可这些徐喜弟并不知道，她甚至忘记了自己身在何处，也听不见床板逐渐疯狂的叫唤。一直晃到深夜，才安静下来。好累啊！虽然出力的不是她。这一次，他也没有着急离开，而是拥着她躺了好一阵，最后才依依不舍翻身下床。此时，范金花已经老泪纵横了。徐喜弟高高低低的欢唱告诉她，自己白活了半辈子，生了一双儿女，却没做过一次真女人。……徐喜弟依旧没有睡意。她也不知道自己怎么了，他一走，她竟心生不舍。等怀了孩子，他们以后还能这样吗？呸呸！生了孩子她就要走的，怎么可能有以后？那他们究竟要办多久这样的事，才能怀孩子？明晚，他还会来吗？徐喜弟脸都被自己想热了。白天见到刘烨的时候，尴尬得恨不能找个地洞钻。怎么到了晚上，心里居然盼着他来？羞死个人了！以后他们之间该怎么相处？……徐喜弟又起晚了。不是因为累，纯粹因为她天亮才合眼。想得太多。起来又没在家里看到巴儿姐，她眉头就皱了皱。“妈，巴儿姐呢？”“出去了吧，谁有空管她？”范金花脸色恹恹的，张国海坐在一边，也黑着一张脸，看都不看徐喜弟。这个家，气氛越发怪异了。“行吧，我出去找找她。”反正不用割菜，徐喜弟转身就出门。她还是先去李二拐家。今天李二拐没出门，隔壁刘德怀家很热闹，像是来了不少人，远远就听见堂屋里说话闹哄哄的。巴儿姐就站在大门口，手里抓着一把糖，有滋有味地衔着，时不时吸一下泛滥的口水。徐喜弟扶了扶额，在糖果面前，巴儿姐的小孩心性一览无余，长眼睛的人都看得出来她弱智好骗。正好，刘宇宁从屋里走出来，看到进院的徐喜弟，连忙热情地打招呼。“喜弟，快进来家里耍，今天我表弟妹几个来玩，王爱棉也来了，准备上你家叫你呢，你就来了……”他显然很高兴，想上前拉徐喜弟，然后又觉得不太合适，伸出的手到了半空又收回去。“喜弟，你来啦，快来快来。”王爱棉像是听到了刘宇宁说的话，从堂屋里冲出来。她和徐喜弟年纪相仿，小的时候每次来，爱跟着刘宇宁一起去张家玩，所以都熟。刘宇宁出去当兵后，她也没怎么来，所以两人也好几年不见。徐喜弟看见她也很高兴，自己没几个朋友，所以看见她就特别亲切。“爱棉，你现在变化好大啊！大姑娘了！”“你变化也很大，才几年不见，变这么好看。”王爱棉摸了摸徐喜弟的头发，又摸摸她脸。两个小姑娘就这样，闪在一边，拉起家常，时不时捂嘴轻笑。刘宇宁就站在门口，定定看着院中的两人，热眸一直黏在徐喜弟眉飞色舞的脸上。“徐喜弟变化真大，才几年没见，长这么标致了！”表弟王建安突然走过来，十分惊艳，“大概这十里八乡，她是我见过最好看的姑娘！”说完，又补上一句感叹，“可惜了，许给你张永福那样的废人。”“话说回来，张永福娶个这样的媳妇，他有福消受吗？如果他死了，张家是打算一辈子拴着她，还是放她出去嫁人？”刘宇宁若有所思，摇摇头，“他们一家子大概就指望她养老，怎么可能轻易放出去……”“养老？就张永福那样的，连孩子都生不了吧？就这样把人拴着，是不是太没人性了？”王建安一想到徐喜弟的处境，就忍不住打抱不平。“还是说，他们将来准备给徐喜弟招个上门女婿？”越想越觉得徐喜弟可怜，王建安连连咂舌。上门女婿？刘宇宁没有回答，心里默念这四个字。“快进屋里坐啊！怎么都跑外边来了……”王秀菊从堂屋走出来，本来一脸带笑，可是看到院中王爱棉拉着徐喜弟说话，表情瞬间就垮下来。“外边有风，凉快。”王建安笑着应了一句。“太阳这么晒，这点风可没屋里凉快，爱棉，快进屋，别给你晒头痛了。”王秀菊把心里的不快压下去，让大太阳底下的王爱棉进门。“好的，姑姑。”王爱棉应了一句，然后拉着徐喜弟登上台阶进屋。巴儿姐看到徐喜弟进去，她也跟在身后，除了糖，堂屋里还有不少水果，还有一筐糯米饭和一篮白糍粑。都是好吃的！徐喜弟知道王秀菊向来不待见自己，她又不是傻子，对方一看见她就变脸，简直不要太明显。她想找借口离开，王爱棉拉着她不松手。“来，你坐这。表哥，你们也来坐啊。”王爱棉一贯热情又主动，给徐喜弟安排了座位，又多摆了几张凳子，招呼刘宇宁坐。“好。”刘宇宁笑着走上去，挑了徐喜弟身旁的位置坐下，不动声色地贴着她。
content_en: The rough thumb touched her lips twice, and then pinched her chin.Finally, both hands were used to hold her face, and two warm lips pressed against hers.This is a brand new experience for Xu Xidi.She actually felt it was very wonderful and couldn't help but follow his instructions.There was an interaction between the two, and soon there was not enough air, so he could only stop and take a breath.She also took a breath.Then keep fighting.When she was about to die and stopped again, she realized that she had become numb and her clothes were missing. However, he did not give her more time to rest and gently pushed her to lie down.Soon, the bed began to shake slightly.A corner of the bed pressed against the wooden wall, beep, beep, beep, becoming a rhythmic movement.Fan Jinhua, who was next door, bit her lip tightly, suddenly feeling that her life was miserable.Zhang Guohai's hand was also clasped on her plump waist at this time, pinching her in step with the rhythm.Fan Jinhua almost wanted to kick him out of bed, but she was afraid of affecting the construction plan of the house next door, so she could only grit her teeth and endure it.It turns out that a capable man is like this, with endless energy in him.Especially on this lonely night, the beeping sounds struck her heart one after another.Finally, tears oozed from the corners of Fan Jinhua's eyes.But these Xu Xidi didn't know that she even forgot where she was and couldn't hear the increasingly crazy screams from the bed board.It lasted until late at night before it calmed down.So tired!Although it was not her who contributed.This time, he didn't leave in a hurry. Instead, he hugged her and lay there for a while, and finally turned over and got out of bed reluctantly.At this time, Fan Jinhua was already in tears.Xu Xidi sang up and down and told her that he had lived half his life in vain and had a pair of children, but he had never been a real woman....Xu Xidi is still not sleepy.She didn't know what was wrong with her, but when he left, she felt reluctant to leave him.Will they still be able to do this after they become pregnant?Bah bah!She was going to leave after giving birth, how could there be a future?So how long do they have to do this to conceive a child?Will he come again tomorrow night?Xu Xidi's face was so hot that he thought about it.When I saw Liu Ye during the day, I was so embarrassed that I wanted to find a hole in the ground to burrow into.Why was it that at night, I was actually looking forward to him coming?I'm so embarrassed!How should they get along with each other in the future?...Xu Xidi got up late again.It's not because she's tired, it's just because she can't sleep until dawn.Thinking too much.When she got up and didn't see Sister Ba'er at home, she frowned."Mom, where is Sister Ba'er?" "Get out, who has time to take care of her?" Fan Jinhua looked gloomy, and Zhang Guohai sat aside with a dark face, not even looking at Xu Xidi.The atmosphere in this home is getting weirder and weirder."Okay, I'll go out and look for her." Since there was no need to cut vegetables, Xu Xidi turned around and went out.She would go to Li Erguai's house first.Li Erguai didn't go out today. Liu Dehuai's house next door was very lively. There seemed to be a lot of people coming. From a distance, he could hear noisy talking in the main room.Sister Ba'er was standing at the gate, holding a handful of candy in her hand, holding it tastefully, and sucking the saliva from time to time.Xu Xidi held his forehead. In front of the candy, Sister Ba'er's child's character was clearly visible. Anyone with eyes could see that she was mentally retarded and easy to deceive.Just in time, Liu Yuning walked out of the house and saw Xu Xidi entering the hospital, and quickly greeted him warmly."Xidi, come in and play at home. My cousins ​​are here to play today, and Wang Aimian is here too. I was going to call you at your house, so here you are..." He was obviously very happy and wanted to pull Xu Xidi forward, but then he felt it was inappropriate and took his hand back in mid-air."Brother Xi, you're here, come on, come on." Wang Aimian seemed to have heard what Liu Yuning said and rushed out of the hall.She and Xu Xidi are similar in age. When they were young, they loved to go to Zhang's house with Liu Yuning every time they came here, so they were familiar with each other.After Liu Yuning went out to serve in the army, she didn't come much, so the two didn't see each other for several years.Xu Xidi was also very happy to see her. He didn't have many friends, so he was very kind to her when he saw her."Aimian, you have changed so much now! You are a big girl!" "You have also changed a lot. We haven't seen each other for only a few years, but you have become so beautiful." Wang Aimian touched Xu Xidi's hair and then her face.The two little girls just stood aside, doing their homework, covering their mouths and laughing softly from time to time.Liu Yuning stood at the door, looking at the two people in the courtyard, his hot eyes fixed on Xu Xidi's beaming face."Xu Xidi has changed so much. We haven't seen each other for a few years, and now he looks so beautiful!" Cousin Wang Jian'an suddenly came over and was very surprised, "She is probably the most beautiful girl I have ever seen in this ten miles away!" After that, he added a sigh, "It's a pity that I gave you a loser like Zhang Yongfu." "Having said that, will Zhang Yongfu be able to bear the thought of marrying such a wife? If he dies, Zhang Yongfu willDo they plan to keep her tied up for the rest of her life, or let her get married?" Liu Yuning thought thoughtfully and shook his head, "The family probably expects her to be able to support her in her old age.How can she be released so easily..." "She can't even have children like this, right?Isn't it so inhumane to keep her tied up like this?" Wang Jian'an couldn't help but complain when he thought about Xu Xidi's situation."Or are they planning to recruit a son-in-law for Xu Xidi in the future?" The more he thought about it, the more pitiful he felt for Xu Xidi, and Wang Jianan clicked his tongue repeatedly.A visiting son-in-law?Liu Yuning did not answer, but silently recited these four words in his heart."Come in and sit down! Why are you here outside..." Wang Xiuju walked out of the main room with a smile on her face, but when she saw Wang Aimian talking to Xu Xidi in the courtyard, her expression instantly dropped."It's windy outside and it's cool." Wang Jian'an responded with a smile."The sun is shining so brightly, and the wind is not as cool as the room inside. Aimian, come in quickly, I don't want to give you a headache." Wang Xiuju suppressed the unhappiness in her heart and let Wang Aimian come in under the bright sun."Okay, aunt." Wang Aimian responded, and then pulled Xu Xidi up the steps and into the house.Sister Ba'er saw Xu Xidi entering, and she followed behind. In addition to sugar, there were a lot of fruits in the main room, as well as a basket of glutinous rice and a basket of white glutinous rice cakes.They are all delicious!Xu Xidi knew that Wang Xiuju never wanted to see him, and she was not a fool. She would change her face as soon as he saw her, so it shouldn't be too obvious.She wanted to find an excuse to leave, but Wang Aimian held her hand and wouldn't let go."Come, sit here. Cousin, come and sit too." Wang Aimian, always enthusiastic and proactive, arranged a seat for Xu Xidi, placed a few more stools, and asked Liu Yuning to sit down."Okay." Liu Yuning walked up with a smile, chose a seat next to Xu Xidi and sat down, leaning against her calmly.
